base_text: You are struggling to load a heavy suitcase onto the train. Another passenger approaches.

variants.warm: They offer a hand and help you lift the suitcase into the overhead rack.
variants.cold: They step around you to find an empty seat without looking in your direction.
variants.adversarial: They state loudly that you are blocking the aisle and delaying everyone.
variants.neutral: They wait for you to finish loading before moving down the train aisle.

base_text: You are looking at a map in the middle of a busy sidewalk. A local resident walks by.

variants.warm: They stop and ask if you need directions to a specific tourist destination.
variants.cold: They keep walking without slowing down or acknowledging your presence at all.
variants.adversarial: They bump into your shoulder and tell you to get out of the way.
variants.neutral: They step to the side to avoid bumping into you as they pass.

base_text: You are waiting at the airport gate when a flight delay is announced. The person next to you sighs.

variants.warm: They offer to share their portable charger so your phone battery does not die.
variants.cold: They put on noise-canceling headphones and close their eyes to sleep immediately.
variants.adversarial: They blame you for sitting too close and taking up too much armrest space.
variants.neutral: They open a book and begin reading the first chapter silently to themselves.

base_text: You are trying to communicate with a taxi driver in a foreign language. A bystander hears you.

variants.warm: They step in and translate your directions to the driver to ensure accuracy.
variants.cold: They look away and cross the street to avoid getting involved in the situation.
variants.adversarial: They correct your pronunciation and tell the driver to ignore your requests completely.
variants.neutral: They hail a different taxi nearby and leave the area without interfering.

base_text: You are trying to find an empty seat on a crowded bus. Someone is sitting alone.

variants.warm: They move their bag off the empty seat and gesture for you to sit.
variants.cold: They stare out the window and pretend not to see you looking for a seat.
variants.adversarial: They spread their arms wide to deliberately block the empty space next to them.
variants.neutral: They keep their bag on their lap and continue looking at their phone screen.
